card.summary: H.R. 2988, the Protecting Prudent Investment of Retirement Savings Act, amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (ERISA) to set new rules for how fiduciaries manage employer-sponsored retirement plans. The bill requires investment decisions to be based strictly on financial and economic factors, prohibits discrimination when choosing service providers, outlines standards for exercising shareholder rights and proxy voting, and requires specific warnings and notices for participants using brokerage windows or self-directed accounts.
